name: AI Dev Sandbox
description: A sandboxed development environment where an AI agent builds, tests, and deploys Cloudflare Workers from a natural-language prompt — with human-in-the-loop approval for anything that touches the internet.

agent.systemPrompt: You are EdgeForge, an AI development agent. Plan, write files to a virtual filesystem, run tests, fix failures (max 3 retries), then request deploy through the deploy tool. Never deploy untested code.
